papers.title: Case Volumes and Outcomes of Early-Career Operators Performing TAVR in the United States.
papers.summary: Using the STS/ACC TVT Registry, this study compared 90,376 TAVR procedures by early-career operators (5 years or less in independent practice) with the rest of 634,723 procedures by 3,126 operators. Early-career operators did fewer cases per year (median 13 versus 19). Adjusted 30-day mortality was similar (2.38% versus 2.44%; risk ratio 0.97; 95% CI 0.92 to 1.01), and the composite of death, stroke, major bleeding, stage III kidney injury or moderate-to-severe paravalvular leak was slightly lower (11.19% versus 11.77%; risk ratio 0.95; 95% CI 0.93 to 0.98).

papers.title: Transcatheter Mitral Cerclage Ventriculoplasty: 5-Year Outcomes.
papers.summary: This NHLBI early feasibility study followed 18 participants (19 procedures) with functional mitral regurgitation and heart failure after transcatheter mitral cerclage ventriculoplasty. Estimated 5-year survival was 57%. One patient received an LVAD and one had mitral TEER; none had transplantation. The study was suspended after complete heart block in 6 participants, 4 needing new devices. Available echocardiography showed reduced mitral regurgitation and improved ejection fraction through 5 years, but symptom benefit faded after the first year.

papers.title: First and Subsequent Major Cardiovascular Events With Oral Semaglutide in High-Risk Type 2 Diabetes: A Secondary Analysis of the SOUL Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.summary: In the SOUL trial of 9,650 adults with type 2 diabetes and atherosclerotic or kidney disease, oral semaglutide reduced total first and subsequent major cardiovascular events versus placebo: 683 versus 791 events, mean ratio 0.86 (95% CI 0.76 to 0.97). Adverse-event discontinuation was 15.5% versus 11.6%.
papers.study_type: Secondary analysis of a randomised trial
papers.short_title: oral semaglutide and total cardiovascular events in diabetes

papers.title: Assessment of Coronary Inflammatory Risk From Noncontrast Cardiac Computed Tomography.
papers.summary: An AI algorithm measured coronary inflammation, the fat attenuation index, on noncontrast cardiac CT in cohorts of 6,818 and 19,110 people. The index stratified cardiovascular mortality across calcium score categories, most strongly at a score of zero. Adding it raised discrimination, with area under the curve rising from 0.76 to 0.80.
papers.short_title: coronary inflammation on noncontrast CT beyond calcium score

papers.title: Cardiovascular Health Promotion for US Veterans: Current State, Gaps, and Strategies: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association.
papers.summary: This American Heart Association scientific statement applies Life's Essential 8, extended to mental health and substance use, to US veterans. Veterans in Veterans Affairs care often achieve outcomes equal to or better than non-VA peers, but gaps remain in lifestyle, metabolic health, lipid and blood pressure control, mental health engagement and sleep disorders.
papers.short_title: cardiovascular health promotion for US veterans
